transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

For the past five months, I've had this overwhelming surge of energy where I feel on top of the world, but then I suddenly get extremely irritable over the smallest things. I just can't seem to sit still or stop talking because my mood is shifting so rapidly. It feels like I'm constantly running on a high-speed motor and can't slow down.
During these past five months, have you had any hallucinations or beliefs that others said were not true, even when your mood was not unusually high or irritable?

Yes, I've definitely seen and heard things that weren't there and had beliefs that others didn't agree with, but that only ever happens when my mood is extremely high and I'm bursting with energy. Those strange experiences completely go away when my mood goes back to normal. They never happen when I'm feeling like my usual self.
Have you ever had a full episode of depression lasting at least two weeks, with low mood or loss of interest nearly every day?
No, I haven't really experienced periods of depression like that. My energy has been quite the opposite, and I've never had a time where I felt down or lost interest in things for weeks.
When you are not feeling unusually high or irritable, do you still ever hear, see, or strongly believe things that other people say are not real?

No, I never experience those things when my mood is normal. They only happen when I'm in that super high, energetic, or irritable state. Once my mood settles down, all of those strange sights, sounds, and beliefs completely go away.
